body.p: A person went and saw a bear going around a small lake. The person stalked the bear. He stalked it, shot and wounded it. The bear rushed upon him. The human fell face down onto the ground. The bear pressed the person. The human was lying, he didn't breathe. The bear watched, how he was breathing, he guarded the person in the night. It pressed, the person was lying there without moving. The bear went off. The human stood up and went off.
